title: Home practical guide and safety card: black and shiny cups in the sun
subject: Science
unit: Summer 1: Metals and their uses (8G); energy transfers (8K)
source: Written for science/y8 lesson 54 (Home practical guide and safety card: black and shiny cups in the sun (portal worksheet; no hot water needed))
intro: Lesson 54: Radiation. A practical to do at home with an adult nearby. Read it all first.

practical.aim: To find out which surface absorbs more infrared radiation
equipment: Cold tap water (no hot water needed)
A sunny windowsill and a timer
safety: An adult knows what you are doing and is nearby
Clear a space and tidy up afterwards; wash your hands
method: Wrap one cup in black paper and the other in shiny foil
Pour the same volume of cold tap water into each
Record the starting temperature of each
Stand both in the same sunny place
Record the temperature every 5 minutes for 30 minutes
Work out each temperature rise and compare

questions.q: Energy transfer that needs no particles is...
Big question: how does the Sun's energy cross empty space?
questions.a: By radiation, which needs no particles.
